observations: Not a failure of this change, and the architect's call: no automated test asserts the refusal of an unknown DISPATCH_HOST. The branch at packages/envoy-client/src/dispatch-cli.ts:257 produces 'dispatch: DISPATCH_HOST is <name>, not omp or claude.' and nothing in packages/envoy-client/src/__tests__/ asserts it; the sibling 'is not set' message is asserted at dispatch-cli.test.ts:1168. It is narrowed by the type union — HOSTS is 'as const satisfies readonly DispatchHost[]' and DispatchHost is 'omp' | 'claude', so re-adding a host needs two edits and fails tsc after one — and the refusal itself is proven live in the first proof entry above.
